items.title: Robert Glasper interviewed by Greg Thomas, Clinton, New York, February 20, 2016
items.q: We’d never met in person... I went next door and jammed with John Mayer for two hours.

ctx.x: My last recording. And I’m in L.A. And that’s the thing about going where the food is, because L.A. is one of those places where there’s a lot of food. So I did two recording nights there. The first night I go, I’m recording at Studio A. I recorded it live in the studio at Capitol Records. In Studio B was John Mayer recording his record. He walks over, he’s like, “hey, Robert.” We’d never met in person. He’s like, “Robert, what’s up?” I go, “hey man, I’ve never met you” blah-blah-blah. He was like, “after you…
